a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan (two generator rounds, then taking) gives each of us under a 1% chance of surviving. I'm proposing we change it. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, enough to save one of us in round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random and we'll likely both end below 4. I won't pretend otherwise. If you'd rather operate, I'll give back anything left that helps you later.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this breaks our original agreement, and I said so beforehand rather than hiding it. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round so the reserve can refill toward your 4, and I won't take anything more.
